paper_ref: Kazius J et al. J Med Chem 2005; 48:312-320
paper_supports: Kazius 2005 defines the structural alerts (toxicophores) used for mutagenicity prediction; a positive prediction = presence of one or more toxicophores.
rule_text: BioMate halts if Ames probability > 0.5 (any toxicophore alert).

paper_ref: Lammert C et al. Hepatology 2010; 51:615-620
paper_supports: Lammert 2010 establishes lipophilicity + daily-dose as the primary DILI-risk drivers; the model provides a probability score rather than a threshold.
rule_text: BioMate halts if DILI probability > 0.5 (operational midpoint).

paper_ref: Redfern P et al. Cardiovasc Res 2003; 58(1):32-45
paper_supports: Redfern 2003 establishes the 30× safety margin between hERG IC50 and free therapeutic Cmax as the industry-accepted cardiac liability cutoff; for a typical small-molecule free Cmax of ~0.3 µM this cor
rule_text: BioMate halts if hERG IC50 ≤ 10 µM (admet_standard profile). The 10 µM operational threshold is confirmed in Bowes 2012 (Nat Rev Drug Discov 11:909-922, DOI 10.1038/nrd3845) as the cross-pharma indust

paper_ref: Lipinski CA et al. Adv Drug Deliv Rev 1997; 23:3-25
paper_supports: Lipinski's Rule of Five: MW ≤ 500, logP ≤ 5, HBD ≤ 5, HBA ≤ 10. Establishes the empirical bounds for oral bioavailability.
rule_text: BioMate halts on >1 Ro5 violation (admet_standard profile).

paper_ref: Genheden S et al. J Cheminform 2020; 12:70
paper_supports: Genheden 2020 introduces aizynthfinder retrosynthesis. The paper recommends generating ≥1 solved synthetic route within a time budget; the specific score thresholds (≥0.9 for "high quality") are reaso
rule_text: BioMate flags compounds with 0 solved routes as PASS-fail and flags max score < 0.9 as WARN.

paper_ref: FDA Estimating the Maximum Safe Starting Dose in Initial Clinical Trials (2005)
paper_supports: FDA 2005 FIH dose guidance describes allometric scaling of animal pharmacokinetic parameters (CL, V) across species to predict human PK. Inter-species power-law fit with R² is the standard quality met
rule_text: BioMate flags allometric fits with R² < 0.85 as low confidence (would not be acceptable in FIH submission).

paper_ref: Sormanni P, Aprile FA, Vendruscolo M. Sci Rep 2017; 7:8200 (CamSol)
paper_supports: Sormanni 2017 reports CamSol intrinsic solubility per-residue scale where >+1 = highly soluble, <-1 = aggregation-prone. Whole-sequence average cutoff is community application of the scale.
rule_text: CamSol score >= 1.0 = pass; 0-1 = advisory; < 0 = FAIL.

paper_ref: Raybould MIJ et al. PNAS 2019; 116:4025-4030 (Therapeutic Antibody Profiler)
paper_supports: Raybould 2019 Table 1 reports total CDR length distribution across clinical-stage therapeutics; CST 5th-95th percentile bounds for total CDR length are 43-63 residues (IMGT numbering).
rule_text: Total CDR length within 43-63 residues = pass; 40-43 or 63-67 = advisory; outside = FAIL.

paper_ref: Raybould MIJ et al. PNAS 2019; 116:4025-4030
paper_supports: Raybould 2019 Table 1 defines TAP PSH (Patches of Surface Hydrophobicity) amber band as CST 5th-95th percentile ≈ 90-150.
rule_text: PSH within 90-150 = pass; outside = FAIL.

paper_ref: FDA Enrichment Strategies for Clinical Trials Guidance (2019); Wang SJ et al. Stat Med 2018
paper_supports: FDA 2019 endorses predictive enrichment when marker-positive shows substantially larger effect. Wang 2018 + Jenkins 2011 operationally use HR <= 0.7 for clinically meaningful enrichment; not in FDA v
rule_text: Biomarker-positive HR <= 0.7 = pass; > 0.7 = FAIL (enrichment unjustified).

paper_ref: Jenkins M
paper_supports: Jennison C. Pharm Stat 2011; 10:347-356; FDA Enrichment 2019
column8: Jenkins/Stone/Jennison 2011 quantify enrichment efficiency for adaptive phase II/III oncology trials; the 1.5 enrichment-factor cutoff is back-derived from this framework

paper_ref: Simon R, Maitournam A. Clin Cancer Res 2004; 10:6759-6763
paper_supports: Simon & Maitournam 2004 show enrichment efficiency depends on biomarker prevalence. The 10-50% efficient window is community convention derived from their efficiency curves.
rule_text: Predicted biomarker-positive prevalence in [0.10, 0.50] = pass; outside = advisory.

paper_ref: Kim S et al. Nat Methods 2018; 15:591-594
paper_supports: Strelka2 paper Table 2 reports 30x depth as a standard for confident somatic variant calls in tumor samples.
rule_text: BioMate flags variants at loci with depth < 30x as low confidence (Strelka2 community standard).

paper_ref: Li H. Bioinformatics 2009; 25:1754-1760
paper_supports: BWA-MEM paper establishes MAPQ scoring; Phred-20 = 99% accuracy is the de facto community convention for filtering low-quality alignments.
rule_text: BioMate flags reads with mean MAPQ < 20; advisory at 10-20; FAIL below 10.

paper_ref: GATK Best Practices for Somatic Variant Calling (Broad Institute)
paper_supports: GATK Best Practices documentation specifies VAF >= 0.05 as the default confident-call threshold for Mutect2 somatic variant calling.
rule_text: BioMate flags variants with VAF < 0.05 as below confident-call threshold (GATK Mutect2 default).

paper_ref: Liu S, Yuan Y. J R Stat Soc C 2015; 64(3):507-523
paper_supports: Liu & Yuan 2015 establishes BOIN dose-escalation boundaries λ_e and λ_d as functions of target DLT rate φ. For φ=0.25, λ_e=0.197 (escalate) and λ_d=0.298 (de-escalate). MTD = highest dose with observe
rule_text: BioMate enforces BOIN decision rules verbatim from Liu & Yuan 2015 Table 2. MTD selection per the paper's algorithm.

paper_ref: Rosenthal PB & Henderson R. J Mol Biol 2003; 333:721-745
paper_supports: Rosenthal & Henderson 2003 establish the FSC 0.143 criterion as the gold-standard resolution metric for single-particle cryo-EM.
rule_text: BioMate flags maps with FSC 0.143 > 4 angstroms as publication-quality threshold; advisory 4-8; FAIL > 15.

paper_ref: Punjani A et al. Nat Methods 2017; 14:290-296
paper_supports: cryoSPARC paper discusses typical drift values; specific cutoff of 50 A is operational community practice for motion-corrected movies.
rule_text: BioMate flags drift > 50 A per movie as advisory; > 100 A as FAIL.

paper_ref: Henderson R. Q Rev Biophys 1995; 28:171-193
paper_supports: Henderson's information-limit theory describes particle counts needed for sub-3 A resolution; the 50K threshold is operational in the modern detector era.
rule_text: BioMate flags reconstructions with < 50K particles for sub-3 A targets.

paper_ref: Hagen WJH, Wan W, Briggs JAG. J Struct Biol 2017; 197:191-198
paper_supports: Hagen 2017 describes dose-symmetric tilt schemes. Typical defocus targets are -2 to -6 um; outside [-8.0, -0.5] is usually a data-collection error.
rule_text: BioMate flags mean defocus outside [-8.0, -0.5] um as FAIL.

paper_ref: Rosenthal PB & Henderson R. J Mol Biol 2003; 333:721-745
paper_supports: Rosenthal & Henderson 2003 establish FSC 0.143 as the gold standard. The criterion applies identically to subtomogram averaging maps as to single-particle cryo-EM.
rule_text: BioMate flags STA FSC 0.143 > 15 angstroms as advisory; > 30 angstroms as FAIL.

paper_ref: Mastronarde DN, Held SR. J Struct Biol 2017; 197:102-113
paper_supports: Mastronarde & Held 2017 describe IMOD alignment; residual < 1 px is community standard for good tilt-series alignment.
rule_text: BioMate flags mean tilt-alignment residual > 1 px advisory; > 3 px FAIL.

paper_ref: FDA In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Guidance (2020)
paper_supports: FDA 2020 DDI guidance specifies R1 (basic model) cutoffs for perpetrator-mediated CYP inhibition: R1 ≥ 1.02 → investigate; R1 ≥ 1.1 → conduct clinical DDI study.
rule_text: BioMate halts when R1 ≥ 1.1 (cyp_ddi_standard profile); advisory when 1.02 ≤ R1 < 1.1.

paper_ref: FDA In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Guidance (2020)
paper_supports: FDA 2020 DDI guidance R2 (mechanism-based inhibition) cutoffs: R2 ≤ 0.79 → investigate; R2 ≤ 0.71 → conduct clinical study.
rule_text: BioMate halts when R2 ≤ 0.71; advisory when 0.71 < R2 ≤ 0.79.

paper_ref: Trott O & Olson AJ. J Comput Chem 2010; 31:455-461
paper_supports: Trott & Olson 2010 introduces AutoDock Vina but does NOT prescribe a binding-score cutoff. The -7 kcal/mol "hit" threshold is community heuristic.
rule_text: BioMate flags binding_score > -7 kcal/mol (advisory) for docking_hit_finding profile.

paper_ref: AutoDock Vina + Glide community practice
paper_supports: Standard docking workflows require ≥3 valid poses for consensus scoring; no peer-reviewed minimum is cited.
rule_text: BioMate flags if n_poses_generated < 3.

paper_ref: Iversen PW et al. J Biomol Screen 2006; 11(3):247-252
paper_supports: Iversen 2006 establishes signal-window as a complement to Z'. Signal-window ≥ 2 is generally accepted as adequate dynamic range, though the paper presents it as a continuous quality metric, not a hard
rule_text: BioMate computes signal window but does not yet enforce a hard gate. Recommended cutoff: SW ≥ 2 (Iversen 2006 convention).

paper_ref: Zhang JH, Chung TD, Oldenburg KR. J Biomol Screen 1999; 4(2):67-73
paper_supports: Zhang 1999 introduces the Z'-factor statistic and explicitly recommends Z' ≥ 0.5 as "excellent" assay quality. Z' between 0 and 0.5 = "doable but marginal"; Z' < 0 = "screen will not work."
rule_text: BioMate flags plates with Z' < 0.5 (configurable via params.min_z_prime). The 0.5 cutoff is the Zhang 1999 "excellent" threshold verbatim.

paper_ref: ICH S5(R3) Guideline on detection of reproductive and developmental toxicity (2020)
paper_supports: ICH S5(R3) §3.1 specifies that for women of childbearing potential (WOCBP), the default safety margin between the highest non-effect dose in animal reproductive toxicity studies and clinical exposure
rule_text: BioMate flags compounds with safety margin < 10× Cmax under the WOCBP scenario (RED) or 10-30× (YELLOW).

paper_ref: Sutter A et al. Regul Toxicol Pharmacol 2013; 67(1):39-52
paper_supports: Sutter 2013 catalogs structural alerts for reproductive toxicity (DART) including known teratogens, endocrine disruptors, and developmental toxicants. The categorical RED/YELLOW/GREEN scheme is BioM
rule_text: BioMate classifies alerts as RED (known teratogen), YELLOW (structural similarity to teratogens), or GREEN (no alerts). Categorical tiers, not numeric thresholds.

paper_ref: ICH S7B Nonclinical Evaluation of Delayed Ventricular Repolarization (2005)
paper_supports: ICH S7B requires both in vitro IKr (hERG) assay and in vivo QT/QTc assessment. Safety margin = hERG IC50 / free Cmax. A margin < 30× indicates need for further QT investigation; < 10× is high cardiac
rule_text: BioMate flags safety margin < 10× as RED, 10-30× as YELLOW, ≥30× as GREEN.

paper_ref: Dutta S et al. Front Physiol 2017; 8:616
paper_supports: Dutta 2017 establishes qNET (net charge difference) as a CiPA proarrhythmia metric. qNET < -30 pC/pF indicates high proarrhythmic risk under the CiPA initiative.
rule_text: BioMate flags qNET < -30 pC/pF as triggering CiPA Tier 2 evaluation (in silico action potential modeling).

paper_ref: Obach RS. Drug Metab Dispos 1999; 27(11):1350-1359
paper_supports: Obach 1999 establishes that in vitro–in vivo extrapolation (IVIVE) from hepatocyte CLint should predict in vivo CL within 2-fold for ~50% of compounds; within 3-fold for ~80%. The 2-fold criterion is
rule_text: BioMate flags IVIVE predictions with |predicted/observed| > 2 as failing the Obach 1999 criterion.

paper_ref: Pang KS, Rowland M. J Pharmacokinet Biopharm 1977; 5(6):625-653
paper_supports: Pang & Rowland 1977 derives the well-stirred and parallel-tube models of hepatic clearance. Well-stirred: CL = Q_h × fu × CLint / (Q_h + fu × CLint). For high-extraction drugs (E > 0.7), the choice of
rule_text: BioMate adopts the well-stirred model as default; flags when extraction ratio E > 0.7 indicates model-choice sensitivity.

paper_ref: Akinc A et al. Nat Nanotechnol 2019; 14:1084-1087 (Onpattro); FDA Liposome Guidance 2018
paper_supports: LNP literature (Akinc 2019, Onpattro CMC) reports RiboGreen-exclusion EE of 85-95% as the clinical-grade target. FDA requires control, not a numeric floor.
rule_text: EE >= 85% = pass; 70-85% = advisory; < 70% = FAIL.

paper_ref: ISO 22412:2017; LNP DLS community convention
paper_supports: ISO 22412 defines PDI as cumulant analysis width metric. Community convention (Akinc 2019 Onpattro CMC) treats PDI < 0.2 as pharmaceutical-grade monodisperse; >0.3 broad.
rule_text: PDI < 0.2 = pass; 0.2-0.3 = advisory; > 0.3 = FAIL.

paper_ref: FDA Liposome Drug Products Guidance (2018); ISO 22412:2017; Akinc A et al. Nat Nanotechnol 2019; 14:1084-1087 (Onpattro)
paper_supports: FDA 2018 requires DLS characterization of LNP size per ISO 22412 but does not prescribe a numeric Z-avg cutoff. Akinc 2019 (Onpattro CMC) reports clinical LNP-siRNA Z-averages typically 60-120 nm.
rule_text: BioMate operational rule: 60-120 nm = pass; 40-60 or 120-150 = advisory; outside = FAIL. Community/literature range, not FDA verbatim.

paper_ref: FDA Bioavailability Studies Guidance (2003)
paper_supports: FDA 2003 BA/BE guidance: AUC extrapolation from last observed concentration to infinity should be ≤ 20% of AUC_inf for the estimate to be reliable. Higher values indicate inadequate sampling duration.
rule_text: BioMate halts when AUC_extrap_pct > 20% (nca_standard); regulatory profile tightens to > 15%.

paper_ref: Gabrielsson J & Weiner D. PK/PD Data Analysis 5th ed.
paper_supports: Standard NCA practice requires ≥3 points in the terminal log-linear phase for lambda_z estimation; lambda_z fit without sufficient terminal coverage gives unreliable half-life estimates.
rule_text: BioMate halts if subjects_with_no_terminal_slope > 2 (nca_standard).

paper_ref: FDA Population Pharmacokinetics Guidance (1999, reaffirmed 2022); NONMEM/nlmixr2 community
paper_supports: FDA requires reporting of model stability/condition diagnostics; the <1000 community convention for covariance matrix condition is from Bonate & Mould/Upton tutorials, not stated verbatim in FDA guida
rule_text: Condition number < 100 = pass; 100-1000 = advisory; > 1000 = FAIL (ill-conditioned, model likely overparameterized).

paper_ref: Savic RM & Karlsson MO. J Pharmacokinet Pharmacodyn 2007; 34:711-726
paper_supports: Savic & Karlsson 2007 establish ~30% as the η-shrinkage threshold above which EBE-based diagnostics and covariate screening become unreliable. The paper explicitly recommends this cutoff.
rule_text: η-shrinkage < 20% = pass; 20-30% = advisory; > 30% = FAIL (EBE-based covariate inference unreliable).

paper_ref: FDA Pop-PK Guidance + NONMEM community practice
paper_supports: FDA requires convergence/stability evidence. The |ΔOFV| < 3.84 community cutoff comes from chi-squared 1 df interpretation, not published as a Pop-PK QC threshold.
rule_text: |ΔOFV| < 1.0 = pass; 1.0-3.84 = advisory; >= 3.84 = FAIL.

paper_ref: Mey ASJS et al. Living J Comput Mol Sci 2020; 2(1):18378
paper_supports: Mey 2020 (Best Practices for Relative Binding Free Energy Simulations) recommends that the sum of free energies around any closed thermodynamic cycle should be < 1 kcal/mol for the calculation to be c
rule_text: BioMate flags RBFE results with cycle-closure |ΔG_sum| > 1 kcal/mol as not converged.

paper_ref: Overgaard RV et al. Diabetes Therapy 2019; 10:649-662
paper_supports: Overgaard 2019 reports the semaglutide PKPD model predictions for weight change vs SUSTAIN clinical trial outcomes. The passing acceptance band for model qualification is ±3 to -6 kg weight change at
rule_text: BioMate validates simulations against the ±3 to -6 kg band at 30 weeks.

paper_ref: FDA Guidance for Industry — PBPK Analyses (2018)
paper_supports: The guidance states the conventional acceptance criterion for PBPK model verification is that predicted PK parameters (AUC, Cmax) fall within twofold of observed clinical values (i.e. 0.5 ≤ predicted/
rule_text: BioMate enforces |log2(AUC_pred / AUC_obs)| ≤ 1 (IND profile, 2-fold) or ≤ log2(3) (screening, 3-fold).

paper_ref: Davies B & Morris T. Pharm Res 1993; 10(7):1093-1095
paper_supports: Davies & Morris 1993 is a table of physiological parameters (organ weights, blood flows, GFR) across species. It does NOT state any systemic-clearance minimum.
rule_text: BioMate flags CL < 0.01 L/h as physiologically implausible for a clinically-significant small molecule. This cutoff is operational, not peer-reviewed.

paper_ref: EMA Guideline EMA/CHMP/458101/2016 (2019)
paper_supports: The EMA PBPK guideline requires verification that the model conserves mass — sum of compartment masses plus cumulative excretion equals the administered dose.
rule_text: BioMate enforces |recovery − 1.0| ≤ 0.05 (IND profile) or ≤ 0.10 (screening profile). Exact tolerance cutoffs are BioMate operational; the principle of mass-balance verification is from the guideline.

paper_ref: FDA Guidance for Industry — PBPK Analyses (2018)
paper_supports: The guidance recommends simulations cover sufficient time to characterise absorption, distribution, and elimination phases — i.e. Tmax should not coincide with the end of the simulation window.
rule_text: BioMate flags Tmax > 80% of simulation_duration_h (IND profile) or > 90% (screening profile). Exact cutoffs are BioMate operational conventions.

paper_ref: Le Guilloux V, Schmidtke P, Tuffery P. BMC Bioinformatics 2009; 10:168
paper_supports: Le Guilloux 2009 introduces fpocket and establishes the druggability score (combining pocket volume, hydrophobicity, and polarity). Score ≥ 0.5 indicates a druggable pocket; < 0.3 is non-druggable.
rule_text: BioMate gates pocket druggability ≥ 0.5 as PASS; 0.3-0.5 as borderline; < 0.3 as FAIL.

paper_ref: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing (2003) §2.1.7.1
paper_supports: ICH Q1A(R2) §2.1.7.1 defines significant change at accelerated conditions (40°C/75%RH, 6 mo) as ≥5% change in assay from initial. The 5% threshold is in the guideline verbatim for the significant-chan
rule_text: Assay loss at 6mo / 40°C / 75%RH < 5% = pass; >= 5% = FAIL (significant change per ICH Q1A R2 — intermediate condition study triggered).

paper_ref: ICH Q6A Decision Tree #4 (1999); Bauer et al. Pharm Res 2001; Brittain 2009
paper_supports: ICH Q6A DT#4 requires polymorphic form control when forms differ in performance. The 10% conversion cutoff is community practice (Bauer 2001, Brittain 2009), not numeric in ICH.
rule_text: Polymorph conversion < 10% during accelerated stability = pass; >= 10% = FAIL (form may be metastable).

paper_ref: ICH Q1E Evaluation of Stability Data (2003) §2.4 + §2.6
paper_supports: ICH Q1E permits shelf-life extrapolation up to 2× long-term data period when conditions met. 24-month target is community/regulatory convention for room-temperature solid orals.
rule_text: 95% LCB on projected shelf-life >= 24 months = pass; < 24 = advisory.

paper_ref: Birmingham A et al. Nat Methods 2006; 3:199-204
paper_supports: Birmingham 2006 demonstrates seed-region (positions 2-8) complementarity as the driver of siRNA off-target silencing. The paper establishes the property; the >=2 mismatch operational cutoff is communi
rule_text: Min seed mismatches across off-target hit list >= 2 = pass; 1 = advisory; 0 = FAIL.

paper_ref: Khvorova A, Reynolds A, Jayasena SD. Cell 2003; 115:209-216
paper_supports: Khvorova 2003 quantitatively demonstrates functional siRNAs exhibit thermodynamic asymmetry favoring antisense-strand loading; functional siRNAs show ΔdG (5' sense - 5' antisense, 5 bp) >= ~0.5 kcal/m
rule_text: Thermodynamic asymmetry ΔdG >= 0.5 kcal/mol = pass; 0-0.5 = advisory; < 0 = FAIL (sense strand will preferentially load into RISC).

paper_ref: Tunyasuvunakool K et al. Nature 2021; 596:590-596
paper_supports: Tunyasuvunakool et al. apply AlphaFold to the human proteome and report per-residue pLDDT distributions, defining the >70 band as the "confident" set used for downstream structural analyses. The paper
rule_text: BioMate flags structures with confident_fraction (frac residues with pLDDT > 70) below 0.70 as advisory. Cutoff is operational.

paper_ref: Tunyasuvunakool K et al. Nature 2021; 596:590-596
paper_supports: Tunyasuvunakool et al. use predicted aligned error (PAE) to characterise inter-domain relative orientation confidence; low PAE between domains indicates the model places them reliably with respect to
rule_text: BioMate flags multi-domain structures with max inter-domain PAE > 8 Å as advisory. Skipped for single-domain proteins where max_pae is not reported.

paper_ref: Jumper J et al. Nature 2021; 596:583-589
paper_supports: AlphaFold supplementary materials define pLDDT bands: >90 high accuracy; 70-90 well-modelled; 50-70 low confidence; <50 often disordered.
rule_text: Recommended gate: mean pLDDT ≥ 70 for downstream docking use.
